summary: Canada Goose Holdings filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing its unaudited condensed consolidated interim financial statements and MD&A for the second quarter and two quarters ended September 27, 2026, plus CEO and CFO certifications and a November 5, 2026 press release. Revenue was C$274.0M versus C$258.8M, gross profit C$182.9M, operating loss C$21.6M, and net loss C$26.3M (C$0.27 per basic share), including C$7.8M of discontinued-operations losses. No transaction, ownership change, or board recommendation is present; this is ordinary periodic reporting for a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a US quarterly earnings filing.
